english: Then this is your shift: today’s chair, your next customer, and how your week is going. We remember your choice.
translation: Zatim ovdje vidiš svoju smjenu: današnju stolicu, sljedeću mušteriju i kako ti ide sedmica. Pamtimo tvoj izbor.

english: Holiday, sick days and contract hours are managed by the shop under
translation: Godišnji odmor, bolovanje i ugovorene sate uređuje salon pod

english: Deposits, card or pay-at-salon, weekly payouts.
translation: Depoziti, kartica ili plaćanje u salonu, sedmične isplate.

english: Pay online or at the salon. Reminders and directions included.
translation: Plati online ili u salonu. Podsjetnici i upute za dolazak uključeni.

english: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay — or simply pay at the salon.
translation: Kartica, Apple Pay, Google Pay — ili jednostavno plati u salonu.

english: Patch tests, consent and allergy notes handled before you arrive.
translation: Testovi na alergiju, saglasnost i bilješke o alergijama riješeni su prije tvog dolaska.

english: Calendar, payments, team rota, stock and loyalty — one app, no setup fee.
translation: Kalendar, plaćanja, raspored tima, zalihe i lojalnost — jedna aplikacija, bez naknade za uvođenje.

english: Uses your taste profile (consent — GDPR Art. 22 explainable)
translation: Koristi tvoj profil ukusa (saglasnost — GDPR čl. 22, objašnjivo)

english: Rest is paid at the shop
This card number does not check out — please re-check it.
translation: Ovaj broj kartice nije ispravan — provjeri ga ponovo.

english: By confirming you authorize StyleNow Demo to collect this amount by SEPA direct debit (demo mandate).
translation: Potvrdom ovlašćuješ StyleNow Demo da naplati ovaj iznos SEPA direktnim terećenjem (demo ovlaštenje).

english: Demo checkout — no real charge is made and nothing you type leaves your browser. Only a masked label like “Visa ····4242” is kept.
translation: Demo plaćanje — ništa se stvarno ne naplaćuje i ništa što upišeš ne napušta tvoj preglednik. Čuva se samo skrivena oznaka poput „Visa ····4242“.

english: Your whole configuration — team, hours, menu, rules, photos, billing, customer notes — as one JSON file you own. Download it before big changes; restore it if anything goes wrong.
translation: Cijela tvoja konfiguracija — tim, radno vrijeme, meni, pravila, fotografije, naplata, bilješke o klijentima — kao jedna JSON datoteka koju posjeduješ. Preuzmi je prije većih promjena; vrati je ako nešto pođe po zlu.

english: Tap an appointment to reschedule it, message the customer, or settle it.
translation: Dodirni termin da ga pomjeriš, pošalješ poruku mušteriji ili ga naplatiš.

english: Pick a range — the chart shows the trend, the panels split it by service, team member and payment method.
translation: Odaberi period — grafikon prikazuje trend, a paneli ga dijele po usluzi, članu tima i načinu plaćanja.

english: Gift cards sold show their outstanding balance — money received for work not yet delivered.
translation: Prodani poklon bonovi prikazuju neiskorišteno stanje — novac primljen za posao koji još nije obavljen.

english: The note field is yours alone — customers never see it.
translation: Polje za bilješke je samo tvoje — mušterije ga nikad ne vide.

english: Open a row to jump straight into that customer’s message thread.
translation: Otvori red da odmah uđeš u razgovor s tom mušterijom.

english: Every customer conversation for this shop, in one place.
translation: Svaki razgovor s mušterijama za ovaj salon, na jednom mjestu.

english: “Can I move my appointment?” usually answers itself — customers can move bookings from their side.
translation: „Mogu li pomjeriti termin?“ obično se riješi samo od sebe — mušterije mogu pomjerati rezervacije sa svoje strane.

english: Roles, branches and weekly hours — the roster here is exactly what customers can book.
translation: Uloge, filijale i sedmično radno vrijeme — ovdje prikazan raspored je tačno ono što mušterije mogu rezervisati.

english: Removing someone who still has booked customers opens a resolver first — nobody gets stranded.
translation: Uklanjanje osobe koja još ima zakazane mušterije prvo otvara alat za rješavanje — niko ne ostaje na cjedilu.

english: Approving leave lists every booked visit inside it, each one a tap to reassign or refund.
translation: Odobravanje odsustva navodi svaku zakazanu posjetu unutar njega, a svaku možeš preraspodijeliti ili refundirati jednim dodirom.

english: Billing details feed every receipt and e-invoice the shop issues.
translation: Podaci za naplatu ulaze u svaki račun i e-fakturu koju salon izdaje.

english: Redeem at checkout — enter the code in the voucher field
translation: Unovči pri plaćanju — unesi kod u polje za vaučer

english: Redeem it at checkout on StyleNow — enter the code in the voucher field when booking at {shop}.
translation: Unovči ga pri plaćanju na StyleNow — unesi kod u polje za vaučer prilikom rezervacije u {shop}.

english: This gift card has been fully used.
translation: Ovaj poklon bon je u potpunosti iskorišten.

english: Bought on this device. The recipient just needs the code — it works in the voucher field at checkout.
translation: Kupljeno na ovom uređaju. Primaocu treba samo kod — radi u polju za vaučer pri plaćanju.

english: A gift card in two minutes — printable, mailable, redeemable at checkout.
translation: Poklon bon za dva minuta — može se odštampati, poslati e-poštom i unovčiti pri plaćanju.

english: Outstanding balances are money received for services not yet delivered — a liability until redeemed.
translation: Neiskorištena stanja su novac primljen za usluge koje još nisu pružene — obaveza dok se ne unovče.

english: {have} of {need} stamps — a full card makes the next visit free
translation: {have} od {need} pečata — puna kartica donosi sljedeću posjetu besplatno
Kartica s pečatima: svaka {n}. posjeta besplatna
Kartica s pečatima (svaka N-ta posjeta besplatna)

english: Your loyalty program, funded by you: {n} completed visits within six months and the next one is free. Stamps and rewards are counted from real bookings — nothing to stamp by hand, nothing to forge.
translation: Tvoj program lojalnosti, koji ti finansiraš: {n} završenih posjeta u roku od šest mjeseci i sljedeća je besplatna. Pečati i nagrade računaju se iz stvarnih rezervacija — ništa se ne pečati ručno, ništa se ne može krivotvoriti.

english: A discount that only applies in your two emptiest day-parts of the last 30 days. Those times carry a badge, so customers see why they’re cheaper.
translation: Popust koji važi samo u tvoja dva najpraznija dijela dana u posljednjih 30 dana. Ti termini nose oznaku, pa mušterije vide zašto su jeftiniji.
{shop} ti je poslao vaučer za izvinjenje od 5 €

english: Your data lives in this browser. Take it with you, or blank the personal parts in place.
translation: Tvoji podaci žive u ovom pregledniku. Ponesi ih sa sobom ili izbriši lične dijelove na mjestu.

english: Blanks your name, phone, notes, memos and message texts everywhere. Amounts and dates stay, so the salons’ books still add up. Cannot be undone.
translation: Briše tvoje ime, telefon, bilješke, podsjetnike i tekstove poruka svugdje. Iznosi i datumi ostaju, pa knjige salona i dalje štimaju. Ne može se poništiti.
nema otkazivanja od strane salona u 90 dana

english: {n}× cancelled, {m}× moved late by the salon (90 days)
translation: {n}× otkazano, {m}× kasno pomjereno od strane salona (90 dana)

english: Late cancel or move by the salon? A €5 sorry-voucher is issued automatically.
translation: Salon kasno otkazao ili pomjerio? Vaučer za izvinjenje od 5 € izdaje se automatski.

english: What the next shift must know…
Completed service revenue per stylist × their percent (set in the team editor). Tips are listed, never commissioned.
translation: Prihod od završenih usluga po frizeru × njihov postotak (postavlja se u uređivaču tima). Napojnice se navode, ali se na njih ne obračunava provizija.

english: This service involves colour chemistry and I have no recent patch test here. I understand the salon may do a quick test first or decline the treatment.
translation: Ova usluga uključuje hemiju boje, a nemam nedavni test na alergiju ovdje. Razumijem da salon može prvo uraditi brzi test ili odbiti tretman.

english: Patch test was done — remember it
translation: Test na alergiju je urađen — zapamti to

english: Patch test recorded for this salon (valid 6 months)
translation: Test na alergiju zabilježen za ovaj salon (važi 6 mjeseci)
Očekuje se test na alergiju — usluga s bojom/hemijom

english: No recent patch test on record for this customer
translation: Nema nedavnog testa na alergiju za ovu mušteriju

english: N visits of one service for a bundle price, paid up front. Uses are counted from real bookings — a card cannot be over-spent, and a cancellation returns the use automatically.
translation: N posjeta jedne usluge po paket cijeni, plaćeno unaprijed. Korištenja se računaju iz stvarnih rezervacija — kartica se ne može prekoračiti, a otkazivanje automatski vraća korištenje.
ai_review_note: pk_hint: wrong case 'jednoj usluzi' and unnatural 'potrošiti previše' fixed ('jedne usluge', 'prekoračiti').

english: {sold} sold · {uses} visits outstanding · {eur} of prepaid work open
translation: Prodano: {sold} · neiskorištenih posjeta: {uses} · otvoreno unaprijed plaćenog posla: {eur}

english: Pay once, come back on your terms.
translation: Plati jednom, dolazi kad ti odgovara.

english: Gift cards in bulk for your team or clients — one order, one invoice, a volume discount from 5 cards (5 %), 10 (10 %) or 20 (15 %). Every code redeems at full face value.
translation: Poklon bonovi u većim količinama za tvoj tim ili klijente — jedna narudžba, jedan račun, popust na količinu od 5 bonova (5 %), 10 (10 %) ili 20 (15 %). Svaki kod se unovčava u punoj nominalnoj vrijednosti.

english: Hand one code to each person — every code is an ordinary gift card at full face value, redeemable in the booking checkout.
translation: Daj po jedan kod svakoj osobi — svaki kod je običan poklon bon u punoj nominalnoj vrijednosti, koji se unovčava pri rezervaciji.

english: The payment page could not be opened just now. Your seat is still held — try again in a moment.
translation: Stranica za plaćanje trenutno se nije mogla otvoriti. Tvoje mjesto je i dalje zadržano — pokušaj ponovo za trenutak.

english: Let guests settle at the counter — card or cash — instead of paying when they book. A deposit, where one is set, is still taken online: that is what holds the seat.
translation: Dopusti gostima da plate na šalteru — karticom ili gotovinom — umjesto pri rezervaciji. Depozit, ako je postavljen, i dalje se naplaćuje online: on drži mjesto.

english: Guests may pay at the salon
When would you like to pay?
Nothing is charged now. {amount} is due at the counter — card or cash, whichever suits.
translation: Sada se ništa ne naplaćuje. {amount} se plaća na šalteru — karticom ili gotovinom, kako ti odgovara.

english: Signed before the seat is held, for colour and needle work. Leave empty to ask for nothing. The wording is stored with the booking exactly as it stood when it was signed.
translation: Potpisuje se prije zadržavanja mjesta, za rad s bojom i iglama. Ostavi prazno ako ništa ne tražiš. Tekst se čuva uz rezervaciju tačno onako kako je glasio kad je potpisan.

english: I confirm I have no known allergy to the products named, and that I understand the result depends on my hair’s condition…
translation: Potvrđujem da nemam poznatu alergiju na navedene proizvode i da razumijem da rezultat zavisi od stanja moje kose…

english: Type your full name to sign
The last 90 days, from the reason people gave at the cancel. One is an anecdote; a pattern is a roster decision.
translation: Posljednjih 90 dana, prema razlogu koji su ljudi naveli pri otkazivanju. Jedan slučaj je anegdota; obrazac je odluka o rasporedu.

english: Customer announced they are about {n} min late
translation: Mušterija je najavila da kasni oko {n} min

english: Withdrawn — the salon expects you on time.
translation: Povučeno — salon te očekuje na vrijeme.

english: Could not tell the salon — the thread is the reliable door.
translation: Nije moguće obavijestiti salon — razgovor je pouzdan put.

english: Custom work has no fixed menu price. Describe what you have in mind and the answer lands in your messages — no booking needed first.
translation: Posao po mjeri nema fiksnu cijenu u meniju. Opiši šta ti je na umu i odgovor stiže u tvoje poruke — nije potrebna prethodna rezervacija.

english: A flat monthly fee for a standing discount on every visit. Recurring revenue for you, a reason to stop shopping around for them. (Demo: the fee is simulated, no money moves.)
translation: Fiksna mjesečna naknada za stalni popust na svaku posjetu. Ponavljajući prihod za tebe, razlog da mušterije prestanu tražiti drugdje. (Demo: naknada je simulirana, novac se ne kreće.)

english: Travels with this device, fills itself into every booking, and disappears with “erase my data”.
translation: Putuje s ovim uređajem, sam se popunjava u svaku rezervaciju i nestaje uz „izbriši moje podatke“.

english: Only promise what the premises actually have — customers plan their trip around this.
translation: Obećaj samo ono što prostor stvarno ima — mušterije prema tome planiraju put.

english: Customers who saved their birthday get this discount automatically in the two weeks around it — a guaranteed annual visit occasion.
translation: Mušterije koje su sačuvale rođendan automatski dobivaju ovaj popust u dvije sedmice oko njega — zajamčena godišnja prilika za posjetu.

english: Colour service: first colour visit here? A patch test 48 h ahead is recommended — just message the salon.
translation: Usluga s bojom: prva posjeta za bojenje ovdje? Preporučuje se test na alergiju 48 h ranije — samo pošalji poruku salonu.

english: Sell a gift card at the counter
Gift card created — hand over the code
Share your code. Your friend gets €5 off their first booking over €25 — and the moment it confirms, a €5 gift card lands on your account.
translation: Podijeli svoj kod. Tvoj prijatelj dobija 5 € popusta na prvu rezervaciju preko 25 € — a čim se potvrdi, poklon bon od 5 € stiže na tvoj račun.

english: This treatment needs a signed consent, and there is only one consent field for the whole party — book each chair separately instead.
translation: Ovaj tretman traži potpisanu saglasnost, a postoji samo jedno polje za saglasnost za cijelu grupu — rezerviši svaku stolicu posebno.

english: The day’s money in one printable sheet — revenue, VAT, tips, fees, refunds, and the split by payment method. Derived live from the calendar, so it can never disagree with it.
translation: Novac dana na jednom listu za štampu — prihod, PDV, napojnice, naknade, povrati i podjela po načinu plaćanja. Izvedeno uživo iz kalendara, pa se nikad ne može razlikovati od njega.

english: Derived from the day’s bookings at the moment of opening. Demo report — not a fiscal document (no TSE signature).
translation: Izvedeno iz rezervacija dana u trenutku otvaranja. Demo izvještaj — nije fiskalni dokument (bez TSE potpisa).

english: Seat reserved — finish payment to keep it.
translation: Mjesto rezervisano — završi plaćanje da ga zadržiš.

english: That time was just taken. Here are the nearest free alternatives:
translation: Taj termin je upravo zauzet. Evo najbližih slobodnih alternativa:

english: ✅ Cancelled in time — {refund} refunded in full.
translation: ✅ Otkazano na vrijeme — {refund} vraćeno u cijelosti.

english: Surge is capped at +25 % platform-wide and never hits returning customers on repeat services.
translation: Poskupljenje je ograničeno na +25 % na cijeloj platformi i nikad ne pogađa stalne mušterije kod ponovljenih usluga.

english: Payment is settled at the shop — the seat is blocked immediately.
translation: Plaćanje se obavlja u salonu — mjesto je odmah blokirano.

english: Type the name from the signed consent before booking this treatment.
translation: Upiši ime sa potpisane saglasnosti prije rezervacije ovog tretmana.

english: Tip: click a free spot to add an appointment; click a booking to open it — details, phone, move, complete or cancel.
translation: Savjet: klikni slobodno mjesto da dodaš termin; klikni rezervaciju da je otvoriš — detalji, telefon, pomjeranje, završetak ili otkazivanje.

english: Shown to customers on your shop page and in search. PNG/JPG, squared works best.
translation: Prikazuje se mušterijama na stranici salona i u pretrazi. PNG/JPG, kvadratni najbolje radi.

english: Missing a category? Add your own
Running several salons? Add each location — they appear as one chain with separate calendars.
translation: Vodiš više salona? Dodaj svaku lokaciju — pojavljuju se kao jedan lanac s odvojenim kalendarima.

english: Demonstration project — no real payments or appointments.
translation: Demonstracijski projekat — bez stvarnih plaćanja i termina.

english: Booked as a business? German bookkeeping systems ingest structured e-invoices (E-Rechnung). This downloads the same receipt as machine-readable XRechnung XML (EN 16931). Private customers don’t need this — the receipt above is your document either way.
translation: Rezervišeš kao firma? Njemački računovodstveni sistemi primaju strukturirane e-fakture (E-Rechnung). Ovo preuzima isti račun kao mašinski čitljiv XRechnung XML (EN 16931). Privatnim mušterijama ovo ne treba — račun iznad je tvoj dokument u svakom slučaju.

english: Generated from this booking’s data and validated against the official KoSIT validator (XRechnung 3.0 rules + EN 16931). Demo notice: the salon data itself is demo data.
translation: Generisano iz podataka ove rezervacije i provjereno službenim KoSIT validatorom (XRechnung 3.0 pravila + EN 16931). Demo napomena: podaci salona su i sami demo podaci.

english: They’re on your bookings page — each can be moved or cancelled on its own.
translation: Nalaze se na tvojoj stranici rezervacija — svaka se može pomjeriti ili otkazati zasebno.

english: Future visits are paid at the salon, visit by visit.
translation: Buduće posjete plaćaju se u salonu, posjeta po posjeta.

english: Tip (not part of the service price)
This receipt is issued by the salon. Keep it for expense claims — salons retain their copies for the statutory period.
translation: Ovaj račun izdaje salon. Sačuvaj ga za potraživanje troškova — saloni čuvaju svoje kopije zakonski propisani period.

english: What your receipts say. The legal name and tax number appear on every customer receipt.
translation: Šta piše na tvojim računima. Pravni naziv i porezni broj pojavljuju se na svakom računu mušterije.

english: Small business (§ 19 UStG) — receipts show no VAT, only the exemption note
translation: Mali preduzetnik (§ 19 UStG) — računi ne prikazuju PDV, samo napomenu o izuzeću

english: That time was just taken — here is what’s still free
translation: To vrijeme je upravo zauzeto — evo šta je još slobodno

english: These customers are already booked into this period. Hand each visit to a free colleague, or cancel it with a full refund.
translation: Ove mušterije su već zakazane u ovom periodu. Predaj svaku posjetu slobodnom kolegi ili je otkaži uz puni povrat.

english: Moved to {name} — the customer has been notified
That colleague just got booked — list refreshed
translation: Taj kolega je upravo zauzet — lista osvježena

english: The shop is calling it off, so the customer pays nothing and gets everything back.
translation: Salon ga otkazuje, pa mušterija ne plaća ništa i dobija sve nazad.

english: No messages with this customer yet. Say hello — a short note before an appointment is the cheapest way to stop a no-show.
translation: Još nema poruka s ovom mušterijom. Pozdravi je — kratka poruka prije termina najjeftiniji je način da spriječiš nedolazak.

english: Replies are public on your shop page. Future customers read how you handle a bad day at least as closely as they read the rating.
translation: Odgovori su javni na stranici tvog salona. Buduće mušterije čitaju kako rješavaš loš dan barem jednako pažljivo kao i ocjenu.

english: That time has just been taken
An offer shows on the customer’s bookings page for 30 minutes with that exact time. It doesn’t hold the seat — first come stays first served.
translation: Ponuda se prikazuje na stranici rezervacija mušterije 30 minuta s tačno tim terminom. Ne zadržava mjesto — ko prvi, njegovo.

english: People who asked to be told when a day frees up. When a cancellation opens a slot, they are the first call to make.
translation: Ljudi koji su tražili da ih obavijestimo kad se oslobodi neki dan. Kad otkazivanje otvori termin, oni su prvi koje treba nazvati.

english: Click a day to book time off for that person; click an existing absence to remove it. Bars show how full a working day already is.
translation: Klikni dan da zakažeš slobodno vrijeme za tu osobu; klikni postojeće odsustvo da ga ukloniš. Trake pokazuju koliko je radni dan već popunjen.

english: An absence removes that person’s hours from the calendar, so no customer can book them while away.
translation: Odsustvo uklanja sate te osobe iz kalendara, pa je nijedna mušterija ne može rezervisati dok je odsutna.

english: Anything the shop should know? (allergies, wishes…)
translation: Nešto što salon treba znati? (alergije, želje…)

english: No customers yet — they appear here as soon as someone books.
translation: Još nema mušterija — pojavljuju se ovdje čim neko rezerviše.

english: People are matched by phone number when they gave one, so the same customer stays one record across their phone, their laptop and the front desk. Private notes are yours alone — customers never see them.
translation: Ljudi se povezuju preko broja telefona kad su ga dali, pa ista mušterija ostaje jedan zapis na telefonu, laptopu i na recepciji. Privatne bilješke su samo tvoje — mušterije ih nikad ne vide.

english: Shuts the whole shop — public holidays, renovation, the summer break. Nobody can be booked on these days, without touching anyone’s roster.
translation: Zatvara cijeli salon — praznici, renoviranje, ljetna pauza. Niko se ne može rezervisati tih dana, a da se ne mijenja ničiji raspored.

english: The rest is cut into start times on the shop’s slot grid, and each candidate must fit the whole service plus the before/after buffers.
translation: Ostatak se siječe na početna vremena na mreži termina salona, a svaki kandidat mora stati cijela usluga plus rezerve prije/poslije.

english: At checkout the seat is held for 8 minutes and the database has the last word — a seat can only ever belong to one booking.
translation: Pri plaćanju se mjesto zadržava 8 minuta, a baza podataka ima posljednju riječ — jedno mjesto može pripadati samo jednoj rezervaciji.

english: {name} still has upcoming appointments — reassign or cancel them below first.
translation: {name} još ima predstojeće termine — prvo ih preraspodijeli ili otkaži ispod.

english: Demo environment — bookings are simulated, no real payments.
translation: Demo okruženje — rezervacije su simulirane, bez stvarnih plaćanja.

english: I accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy (required)
translation: Prihvatam Uslove korištenja i Politiku privatnosti (obavezno)

english: Demo session — real OAuth activates once the provider is enabled in Supabase.
translation: Demo sesija — pravi OAuth se aktivira kad se provajder uključi u Supabaseu.

english: Almost there — confirm the link we just emailed you, then sign in.
translation: Skoro gotovo — potvrdi link koji smo ti upravo poslali e-poštom, pa se prijavi.

english: Everything stored about you — GDPR Art. 20.
translation: Sve što je pohranjeno o tebi — GDPR čl. 20.

english: Really delete your account and profile? Bookings history in shops stays for legal retention.
translation: Zaista izbrisati tvoj račun i profil? Historija rezervacija u salonima ostaje zbog zakonskog čuvanja.

english: This signs you out everywhere and removes your profile. It cannot be undone.
translation: Ovo te odjavljuje svugdje i uklanja tvoj profil. Ne može se poništiti.

english: 🗑 Your profile, preferences and favourites are deleted.
translation: 🗑 Tvoj profil, postavke i omiljeni se brišu.

english: 🔒 Past receipts stay with the salons — German law requires them to keep invoices for the statutory retention period.
translation: 🔒 Prošli računi ostaju u salonima — njemački zakon zahtijeva da čuvaju fakture zakonski propisani rok.

english: 📅 Upcoming appointments are NOT cancelled. Cancel them first if you do not want to go.
translation: 📅 Predstojeći termini NISU otkazani. Prvo ih otkaži ako ne želiš doći.
